Case Studies Our past work with Healthcare and Pharma organizations

Diabetic Retinopathy Detection using Computer Vision ‹#›   Diabetic Retinopathy is the leading cause of blindness in the working-age population of the developed world. It is estimated to affect over 93 million people Need of expertise and equipment required to detect DR is very high and is often unavailable in areas where requirement is high. Images are classified into four classes according to their retinopathy grades: Input Images are processed using Image Processing techniques ML techniques such as neural networks and classifiers are used Successful classification into one of the four class Results Successful in predicting Retinopathy of severity grade 2 and 3 with more than 90% accuracy If fundus images for both the eyes of the patient are available, the model will predict Retinopathy 2/3 with 99+ percent accuracy!

Medical Term Extraction from Clinical letters using NLP ‹#›   Key Objectives Extract key medical term from the clinical letters shared across medical practitioner Dear Dr Clinic notes Many thanks for referring this lady who last year was awoken at night by moderately fast regular palpitations which had a gradual offset. These symptoms have not recurred. She is otherwise well although is on treatment for hypertension. She stopped smoking 60 years ago and drinks rarely. Recent thyroid function tests have shown a slightly elevated TSH but a normal free thyroxine. Apart from amlodipine 5 mg daily, she takes simvastatin and calcium supplements. Her ECG showed sinus rhythm with a leftward axis. Ambulatory monitoring has shown sinus rhythm with first degree heart block at lower rates and two short salvos of atrial tachycardia of no more than 2 seconds. She was asymptomatic to these.

I would pass her tape as within normal limits for the patient, and in the absence of ongoing symptoms would not suggest any specific treatment. I will arrange for an echocardiogram, however, and will write back further with the results. If she does suffer further palpitations, a small dose of bisoprolol such as 1.25 mg daily would be reasonable. With many thanks for your referral. Yours sincerely cc list Consultant Results Demo : Mediterm Extraction Solution

Entity and Intent Detection for Nursing Notes using NLP ‹#›   Key Objective : Create a model than can generate entity and intent at par with human expert Each Sentence is traverse through High level models followed by Sub-level models Two-level Approach Leveraging multiple NLP frameworks for smart detection AI/ ML Driven Easily scalable and can be modified to support multilingual input Multi-Lingual support Key Features Can’t raise left upper limb, but right upper limb is okey. Both lower limb don’t perform default action. can not raise left upper limb. right upper limb is okey. both lower limb do not perform default action. can not raise left upper limb : Intent -> paralyzed right upper limb is okey. : Intent -> not paralyzed both lower limb do not perform default action.

: Intent -> paralyzed Results and Outcomes AlgoAnalytics model results are at par with IBM Watson results The model was able to detect additional relevant entities, which were either not mentioned or missed in the list by human expert Client: Research project with NTT Data Japan Text Processing Entity Recognition Intent Detection

Pathology Lab Report Parsing using NLP ‹#›   Key Objective : Extract relevant details from pathology lab reports Stage 1 : Identifying Terms and Patterns (Unsupervised Learning) Pathology Lab Reports Stage 2 : Classification of Text into specific Categories (Supervised Learning) The lab report parsing extracts the unstructured data from pathology lab reports and translate to structured data which is useful for downstream applications Demo : Pathology Lab Parsing Better Patient Management for hospitals and medical agencies Effective Patient Care Creating and Compiling Patient Record

Discharge Summary using NLP ‹#›   Key Objective : Automate Discharge summary using information extraction approach Leveraging the power of AI to not only extract relevant information but also identify insights from the categorized text Color coding scheme for the Generated Discharge Summary: Green Color : Able to find data from data source Red Color : Not able to find data from data source Blue Color : Need to be filled by doctor Multiple reports are taken as input fields for generating discharge summary CLINICAL_NOTE OPERATIVE_REPORT PATHOLOGY INVESTIGATION REPORT RADIOLOGY INVESTIGATION REPORT Demo : Discharge Summary Application

Patient Condition Prediction – Early Warning System TO-BE NEWS tends to give many false alarms NEWS may not generate alarm until rapid deterioration is observed Build predictive system, than detective system, based on physiological measurements of hospital inpatients Clinical: Prediction of medical condition Operation: Generation of timely alerts Research: Patient segmentation based on the patterns observed/emerged AS-IS National Early Warning System NEWS Scoring system pertaining to patient medical condition Based on the physiological parameters such as BP, RR, PR, O2S and TEMP Magnitude of score depends on variation in parameter from the norm Alert is generated based on the rules applied to aggregated score .  ‹#›
